reason: Expert provides a troubleshooting rule and successful fix for a microwave link losing alignment after a storm, advising to check mount bolts rather than replacing the radio.

knowledge.summary: When a microwave link loses alignment after a storm, check the pole mount bolts first as they often loosen; tighten them and re-align rather than replacing the radio.
knowledge.author: Jari Jänne
knowledge.details: Two bolts were loose on the pole mount, causing the dish to turn slightly.
